notes.title: Broken Achievement Removed
notes.notes:
After a new update the "Truly Balanced" achievement no longer works. 
After deciding that the achievement is unintuitive and unnecessary I have removed it.

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
If you haven't played Untitled Space Game yet now is the time. The new tutorial is designed to help new players grasp the mechanics of the game. 

Also the new item names should help clear up confusion over what the different items and weapons do.

If you haven't left a review please consider doing so as any feedback can help me improve the game.

Have fun and happy playing! :)

notes.title: Untitled Space Game V112
notes.notes:
Additions
-The game is now fun
-Removed sprays as they were too hard to use
-Changed ship models to be realist humans
-Bullets now produce blood on impact
-Removed main menu
-Achievements no longer work
-Added walls to the side of the map
-Added multiple maps including Dust2
-Shilds now use nVideo Physic (singular)
-The AI now cries when you win too much
-Added online mode but you can only play against me ($20 fee)
-If you die in the game you die in real life
-The game now has a ten percent chance of shutting down on startup
-Deleted the game for everyone so you have redownload it
-Ships now follow mouth direction

notes.notes: Whoops game broke again, and even better when I was about to fix it I got a power outage. :) So that's why it wasn't working for a day. It should update, if not uninstall then reinstall. Have Fun!

notes.title: Untitled Space Game V2 is now live!
notes.notes:
Normal mode is the new simple mode. 

Buy dashes sprays and guns, earn money for killing your friends, get better weapons, buy shields, faster movement, new snipers and crazy sprays. 

But most importantly, have fun!
